# Audio fixtures

These WAV files are versioned because they are useful, deterministic inputs for
renderer and DSP regression checks. Generated render outputs must not be written
here; CI writes them under `$RUNNER_TEMP` and local runs should use `build/`,
`out/`, `renders/`, or another ignored directory.
